content: Hi! How can I help you today?
I have four rental properties but can't deduct the losses due to passive limits.
You should elect to **aggregate your rental activities** under **Reg. §1.469-9(g)**. That increases your chance of meeting the **material participation tests**—particularly the **500-hour** test.
Attach a written statement to your **Form 1040**, listing each property and declaring your election to treat them as a single activity. Keep that on file annually.
Yes. The election remains in effect until you revoke it with IRS consent. **Most real estate professionals lock this in once to protect loss deductions long-term.**
